payload.objective: Report completion of M2.6 Slice 1 backend implementation and test verification; request supervisor architectural review and checkpoint authorization.
payload.explicit_request: Completed M2.6 Slice 1 backend implementation. All 64 tests pass with 0 regressions. User.php untouched. Requesting supervisor review and checkpoint authorization.

task_report.summary: Implemented M2.6 Slice 1: R21 Drawing Hall backend controller, 4 Eloquent models, database migration, routes, and comprehensive feature test suite conforming strictly to Kerala SBTE Regulation 11.2.3. All 64 tests pass with zero regressions.

tests.output: Tests: 64 passed (473 assertions) in 5.05s. R21DrawingControllerTest: 9 passed (57 assertions). Zero regressions.

payload.reason: M2.6 Slice 1 is architecturally approved for checkpointing. The implementation covers the analyzed R21 Drawing backend scope: the four required persistence models and migration, authenticated controller endpoints, formative sheet evaluation, summative series-test evaluation, attendance slabs and overrides, consolidated 50-mark CIA computation, course-file initialization, lesson-plan generation, grading, print data endpoints, routes, and dedicated feature verification. The dedicated Drawing suite passes 9 tests with 57 assertions and the full application suite passes 64 tests with 473 assertions, with zero reported failures or regressions. The User.php safety boundary remains intact. The implementation also stays within the approved backend scope and introduces no UI infrastructure, so the global shell/component directives remain binding for the subsequent M2.7 workspace and print migration. M2.7 must use <x-layouts.workspace-layout> for the Drawing Hall, <x-layouts.report-layout> for all four print templates, existing <x-ui.*> components, and sub-500-line Blade decomposition. The reported working tree is not clean, so checkpoint/commit handling must preserve only the authorized M2.6 changes and must not absorb unrelated modifications. Subject to that clean-scope checkpoint discipline, M2.6 Slice 1 is accepted and may proceed to checkpointing.
